criteria.text: Fork real-child synthetic executable records accepted env; callback resolution alone is not applied. Successful owned default start reports only injected names. Borrowed/nondefault, spawn error, probe failure, filtered invalid value, timeout and late callback never become applied.
criteria.test_id: issue-1569-s4-w5: actual owned child receipts report only filtered names after host acceptance
criteria.reason: Fork receipt and real native hermes:connection IPC tests pass against a synthetic owned child; main broker correlation and packaged child observation are separate acceptance work.

criteria.text: Failed attempt followed by successful retry, duplicate/reordered lifecycle callbacks, normal exit and detach cannot reuse or retain stale applied status. Configured consent remains after ordinary stop.
criteria.test_id: issue-1569-s4-w6: failed attempt, retry, and ordinary exit retire distinct attempts
criteria.reason: Fork failure, retry, exit, and fresh-child tests pass; duplicate and reordered callbacks, retained consent, and provider-level applied state require main broker tests.

criteria.text: Revoke while running shows pending-next-start + retention warning; next owned start lacks key. Identity change while starting disposes eventual child before new identity start; failed disposal stays unavailable. No callback/serial-queue deadlock.
criteria.test_id: issue-1569-s4-w7: disposal waits for pending broker and prevents late accepted receipt
criteria.reason: Fork in-flight and failed-stop disposal tests pass; revoke status, next-start key exclusion, identity barrier, and queue behavior require main adapter/broker tests.
